value.rationale: A natural restricted BML model-representation problem admits a complete finite-star classification and exact least-stage-arrow presentations that preserve all stage reachability. The mandatory scope resource accounting changes the optimum, notably when the root joins a strong component, and yields a sharp global budget with an exceptional four-leaf case. One bounded modal formula separates every relation using legal persistent valuations. This is a motivated constructive classification, not a claim of novel unconstrained transitive reduction or novel integer sequences.
